task_completion.description: Creation of at least three interior partition walls and at least two doors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three new wall segments added inside the original shell and at least two door icons/models placed within walls to connect areas.

task_completion.description: Definition and labeling of at least four distinct zones (e.g., Woodshop, 3D Print Farm).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for text labels or room names on the 2D floor plan or 3D view identifying four separate functional areas.

task_completion.description: Application of different floor colors or textures to at least three zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Observe the 3D view or floor plan for at least three distinct colors or patterns on the floor surfaces of different rooms/zones.

task_completion.description: Placement of at least 10 workbenches or tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 10 table-like objects (workbenches, desks, dining tables) in the furniture list or the 3D layout.

task_completion.description: Placement of at least 10 chairs/stools and 8 storage units.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 10 seating items (chairs, stools) and 8 storage items (cabinets, shelves, wardrobes) in the furniture list or layout.

task_completion.description: Placement of at least 6 lighting fixtures and 3 decorative items, totaling at least 40 items overall.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 6 lamps/lights and 3 decor items (plants, curtains, etc.). Verify the total furniture list count reaches 40.

task_completion.description: Save the completed layout to overwrite the starter file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the agent clicking the 'Save' icon or selecting File > Save, and check if the filename in the title bar matches 'makerspace_starter.sh3d'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the space.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the 3D view, rather than just executing scripts in a terminal.

integrity.description: The layout shows a logical progression of design rather than an instant appearance of a finished file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show walls being drawn and furniture being dragged and dropped into place over time.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made completed file from an external source.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen interacting with the 'makerspace_starter.sh3d' file specifically and using the built-in catalog.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires modifying 'makerspace_starter.sh3d'. The agent must place 40+ items total: 10 tables, 10 chairs, 8 storage units, 6 lights, and 3 decor items. It must also include 3+ interior walls, 2+ doors, 4+ labeled zones, and 3+ different floor textures. The pass threshold is 70/100.
